title: V5: fix live attester preflight count (cluster member = instance_id)
brief: First CY test after slot-metrics/preflight: `waiting_for_attester live_attesters=0` forever while attester is connected and attest path works when forced. Root cause: `count_live_cluster_attesters` matches `cluster_cfg.members` against trusted_peers map key / `trusted.node_id` (wire `--node-id`, e.g. cy-attester) but CY lab members are `--node-instance-id` values (e.g. cy-quorum-attester). Proposer never reaches Ready preflight.

root_cause.canonical_member_id: peer_member_id(trusted) = TrustedPeer.instance_id — same as RFC16 cluster attest in transport/peer_session/mod.rs
root_cause.secondary: uses PeerStatus::Connected only; rest of transport uses is_peer_liveish (Accepted|Connected|Retrying)

fix_count_live_cluster_attesters: Resolve member_id via instance_id (reuse peer_member_id logic or move helper to transport/health.rs as pub(crate) count_live_cluster_attesters(hs, cluster_cfg, local_member_id))
Exclude local proposer: member_id == app.node_instance_id.trim() (not wire node_id vs hs.local_instance_id key compare)
Require cluster_role Attester + cluster_attest_enabled on TrustedPeer
observability: On transition to Ready: keep cluster_attest_ready live_attesters=N
Optional debug (behind trace): skipped peer reasons once per connect — only if trivial
tests: Unit: trusted_peers entry wire_id=cy-attester, instance_id=cy-quorum-attester, member in cfg, peer Connected → count=1
Unit: member mismatch wire-only without instance_id → count=0

acceptance_criteria: CY: after attester+proposer up, proposer logs cluster_attest_ready live_attesters=1 (quorum_k=1) within connect window, not perpetual waiting_for_attester
Seals proceed without manual workaround; seal_suppression_summary slots sane
cargo test -p pwmd --lib lifecycle (new count_live tests)
No regression: solo cluster_enabled=false still Ready

primary: crates/pwmd/src/transport/health.rs or peer_session/mod.rs (shared member_id helper if extracted)

operator_verify: Start attester then proposer; grep waiting_for_attester (should stop) and cluster_attest_ready live_attesters=1; height advances ~1/s

delegation.invite_note:
HOTFIX — live attester count always 0.

count_live_cluster_attesters compares cluster members (node-instance-id) to wire node_id keys — wrong.

Fix: match peer_member_id(instance_id) like cluster attest path; exclude app.node_instance_id; use is_peer_liveish.

CY: cy-quorum-attester member vs cy-attester wire id.

Tests + verify cluster_attest_ready. project_id 5.
